name: Call of Water

angles.text: As a shaman, you gather water for a sapta and prove your devotion and perception across distant waterways before you commune with the water spirits.

faq.answer: Hervdana Saegrund gives it from the Wetlands. She studies water sources and the reagents needed to craft a sapta for an aspiring shaman's spiritual trials.
faq.q: Who gives this quest and where are they located?

faq.answer: Hervdana suspects venom, dark magic, or corruption may be seeping over Stonewatch Falls from the old fort above and deforming the murlocs below. She asks you to bring back a fresh sample for her to examine.
faq.q: Why are you sent to collect water from Stonewatch Falls?

faq.answer: No. The water is pure and uncontaminated. Hervdana finds that local shadowseers' dark magic twists the murlocs.
faq.q: Is the water at Stonewatch Falls actually tainted?

faq.answer: Nightcrawler murlocs near the falls are larger and more twisted than those in the Loch or Wetlands. Hervdana traces the change to the foul magic of local shadowseers.
faq.q: Why are the murlocs around Stonewatch Falls so large and twisted?

faq.answer: A sapta lets a shaman pierce the veil and perceive elemental spirits. Hervdana gathers pure water from various sources to brew the reagent for your spiritual trials.
faq.q: What is the water sample used for?

faq.answer: Norric is an associate or mentor involved in the shamanic trials. Hervdana says Norric will be pleased when you return with pure water.

sections.body: Hervdana Saegrund sends you south from the Wetlands to examine the waters at Stonewatch Falls in Redridge. Lake Everstill supplies clean water to Lakeshire, but murlocs lurk beneath the cascade. They have grown unusually large and twisted. Hervdana suspects venom, foul sorcery, or seepage from the old fortress above. She asks you to gather a sample in an Empty Red Waterskin.
sections.title: A Suspect Cascade

sections.body: Hervdana Saegrund finds the water from Everstill clean and untouched by pollution. Dark sorcery from shadowseers near Stonewatch has twisted the Nightcrawler murlocs, not tainted water. The sample proves the falls are pure and that you are devoted to your trials. It is also a vital reagent for brewing a spiritual sapta.
sections.title: The True Source of Corruption

summary: Hervdana Saegrund sends you from the Wetlands to test the waters at Stonewatch Falls in Redridge. What you bring back will serve in your spiritual trials.
